title: Decompress Hap’s texture data directly into GPU-owned storage

definition.title: Decompress Hap’s texture data directly into GPU-owned storage
definition.source_excerpt: Parse bounded Snappy literal/copy jobs without expansion, reconstruct texture-block bytes on GPU and perform legal compressed texture copies. Verify exact bytes and overlapping-copy dependencies; compare CPU decompression plus upload.
